name: io.github.tonyyang0504/trendyol-mcp
description: Trendyol (ecommerce channels): me, update_listing, set_inventory, end_listing, list_orders. Every to

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TRENDYOL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API KEY from Seller Center > Hesap Bilgilerim / Account Information > Entegrasyon Bilgileri / Integration Information (visible to the master/admin user only; PROD and STAGE differ); HTTP Basic username.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TRENDYOL_API_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: API SECRET KEY from the same page; HTTP Basic password.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TRENDYOL_SELLER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Your Trendyol seller (supplier) ID from the same Integration Information page; used in every path.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TRENDYOL_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Mandatory User-Agent (requests without it get 403): '<sellerId> - SelfIntegration' for your own software, or '<sellerId> - <IntegratorName>' (alphanumeric, max 30 characters) when an integrator company runs it, e.g. '1234 - SelfIntegration'.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TRENDYOL_API_HOST
environmentVariables.description: apigw.trendyol.com (PROD) or stageapigw.trendyol.com (STAGE, IP-authorised test environment).
